English:
Well, well, I hear you're
lookin' to marry some rich dude.
So!? Get out of my business, you nosy jerk!

Where're you going to find a guy like that who's
naive enough to give you the time of day?

That's for me to know!
Besides, you shouldn't be talking.
Now, if I was getting married,

and there was this manipulative,
foul-mouthed, but very spunky girl

with a pony tail who flies
around everywhere on a broom...
...I'd turn her down in an instant.
